correctness.rationale: Cyclotomic factorization makes degree multiplicities coefficients of a subset-sum generating polynomial. For the 2-power layer, the coefficient sequence is exactly 1,2,...,2,1. Every interior degree exists by Thompson's criterion. Any representation with an interior layer subtotal already contributes at least two subsets; an all-endpoint representation is converted explicitly to an interior one, with separate carry identities for p<=2^a-1 and the boundary p=2^a+1. Complement symmetry handles endpoint vectors beginning with zero. Degree 1 has exactly the two choices Phi_1 and Phi_2, proving the minimum is exactly two.

value.rationale: Phi-practicality is defined by existence in every degree; classifying when those degree realizations are unique is a natural second-order structural question. The theorem gives a complete uniqueness classification and sharp minimum multiplicity on the entire even two-prime-support family, rather than an arbitrary finite slice or a routine recomputation.
